geometry.sql:
WITH region AS (
            SELECT ST_UnaryUnion(ST_Collect(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Transform(geom,3035),150))) g
            FROM admin_area WHERE dataset_id=:dataset AND level='state'
        ), area AS (SELECT g g FROM region),
        cells AS (SELECT c.i,c.j,ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(c.geom,a.g),3) g
            FROM area a CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_SquareGrid(:size,a.g) c
            WHERE ST_Intersects(c.geom,a.g))
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i::text||'_'||j::text,
            'cx',(i+0.5)*:size,'cy',-(j+0.5)*:size) ORDER BY j,i) cells,
            (SELECT ST_AsSVG(g,0,0) FROM area) outline,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(g)-:size,-ST_YMax(g)-:size,
                ST_XMax(g)-ST_XMin(g)+2*:size,ST_YMax(g)-ST_YMin(g)+2*:size] FROM area) viewbox,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),
                          ST_XMax(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMax(ST_Transform(g,4326))] FROM area) bounds
        FROM cells WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g)
